context_regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda) 200 mg runs into a vein over about 30 minutes. There is no platinum or paclitaxel in this maintenance infusion. One infusion every 3 weeks (21 days). The team confirms the first maintenance date from your actual last treatment.
key_points: Adult persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer, validated PD-L1 combined positive score (CPS) ≥1, ECOG 0–2 and completion of the induction chemotherapy component. Select monotherapy only when a pembrolizumab-alone maintenance plan has been confirmed.

00817 and 00811 use 6–8 three-weekly induction chemotherapy cycles, with consultant review after six. On 00811 both pembrolizumab and bevacizumab may continue as maintenance: confirm the intended partner before choosing a single-agent route. Reconcile the last administered date and current 200 mg/21-day schedule to avoid overlapping visits. Continuing pembrolizumab from induction is continuation of the same course. Avoid treating the change of phase as a new course for duration review.
Among 548 patients with CPS ≥1, median overall survival was 28.6 versus 16.5 months in the pembrolizumab versus placebo regimen (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.49–0.74).
context_regimen_profiles.review_status: Feasibility build. Independent clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

longitudinal_schedule.title: Tests and timing

rows.label: At maintenance handover
cells: Blood count, kidney and liver tests, blood glucose and thyroid function. The team confirms your tumour PD-L1 test and reviews side effects from the earlier combination.
List any steroids or hormone replacements and tell the team about autoimmune illness, diabetes or previous immunotherapy reactions.

rows.label: Before each infusion
cells: Blood count, kidney and liver tests, blood glucose and a review of changes in breathing, bowels, skin and energy.
Bring your alert card and medicines list. Ring between visits about new symptoms, even if your last blood tests were normal.

rows.label: Every 3–6 weeks
cells: Thyroid blood tests check for immune inflammation. Cortisol is checked when your symptoms or the clinical assessment suggest it is needed.
Ask for your blood test dates and the date for your next scan.

longitudinal_schedule.note: Your team books scans and any extra blood tests according to your symptoms and treatment plan.

administration.schedule: One infusion every 3 weeks (21 days). The team confirms the first maintenance date from your actual last treatment.

factors: Adult persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer, validated PD-L1 combined positive score (CPS) ≥1, ECOG 0–2 and completion of the induction chemotherapy component. Select monotherapy only when a pembrolizumab-alone maintenance plan has been confirmed.
